professionalSummary: Deployed sixty-one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline. (src_9688e6247801)

(src_a708492aca95)
Watched the live settlement queue on cut-off days from the operations bridge, recording in the cut-off log which interventions were mine and which belonged to the operations desk. (src_f5ac8b17030e)

Documented the service's known limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change ticket's closure note and in the settlement runbook. (src_ba46bf749dd9)
